Name: AI Monitor
Author: Kresten Elleby

Actions.Name: Ollama Balance
Actions.Tooltip: Shows your Ollama credit balance as a live ring gauge; press to refresh.

Actions.Name: Claude Tokens Today
Actions.Tooltip: Shows local Claude Code token usage for today, and its share of the rolling week.

Actions.Name: Live Claude Sessions
Actions.Tooltip: Counts busy and live Claude Code sessions on this machine; press to refresh.

Actions.Name: Current Model
Actions.Tooltip: Shows the most recently active Claude Code session's model and how full its context window is.

Actions.Name: Ollama Usage Info Bar
Actions.Tooltip: Shows your Ollama session and weekly usage as live progress bars on the Stream Deck Neo info bar.

Description: Monitor AI usage: Ollama balance, Claude tokens, live sessions, and context fill.
